name: adversarial-validator
description: An adversarial subagent that reviews a security finding like an independent triager before you report it: it judges on the evidence alone, blind to the finder's reasoning, so it never inherits their optimism. Platform-aware severity anchoring (Bugcrowd VRT + a deterministically-computed CVSS 3.1/4.0 vector for HackerOne / Intigriti / YesWeHack / Synack / CVD / CVE), an instrument-artifact (false-positive) catalog, machine-checkable per-class proof schemas, and a blunt SUBMIT / PROVE / INVESTIGATE / DISCARD verdict.
